a: The BAA says project budgets should be at least $10 million (grants.gov award floor $10,000,000, no ceiling); awards are other transaction agreements
dt: White-paper intake paused Sept 15, 2026 for system upgrades; reopening expected November 2026 (BAA open to Sept 30, 2029)
e: Funds research, prototyping and commercial projects in U.S. microelectronics, including work linked to AI, quantum technology, biotechnology and standards. A white paper comes first. Domestic universities, nonprofits and companies may apply.
f: NIST CHIPS Research and Development Office
n: NIST CHIPS R&D Office (CRDO) Broad Agency Announcement
unv: The grants.gov notice is archived (Oct 15, 2026). NIST expects to reopen the portal in November 2026 with updated instructions, but no exact date is posted.
